verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST developer API with a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec and Swagger UI on each instance. It does not mention any official SDK or client libraries (e.g., Python or JS packages). A raw API and spec are developer building blocks from which an SDK could be generated, not the official-SDK capability itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
